description: SECURES-Energy: Hourly electricity demand and supply profiles for historical climate and climate change projections in Europe until 2100 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Franziska Schöniger, Gustav Resch (TU Wien). --- v2 open --- --- v1 restricted --- SECURES-Energy Weather-dependent renewable electricity systems are vulnerable to climate change impacts. Electricity generation and demand profiles considering weather and climate impacts are needed in energy system modelling. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
